paite: Zion ah pengkul mut unla, ka tang siangthou ah kigalginna puang un; hiai gamsung a mi tengteng ling uhen; TOUPA ni hong tung ding, anaita hi.
heading: Khaukhup A Gawtna Mulkimhuai

paite: Mialna leh khonimna ni, mei kai ni leh mial sah ni, tangte tung a phalvak tangkhia bang a mipi tampitak leh hattak, huchibang om ngei nai lou, tunung a suan tampi tan a leng om nawn ngei sam lou ding ahong tung ding hi.
Amaban uh mei in akangsiang a; anunglam uh meikuang in ahul a; ama ua gam lah Eden huan bang ahi, anunglam ua gamdai gamkeu ahi a; ahi, bangmah in huai apel kei uh.
Alatdan uh sakol latdan bang ahi; sakol tungtuangmi bang in atai uhi.
Kidouna kangtalai ging bang in tang tung ah akilek suausuau ua, buhpawl kang kuang luahluah leh kidouna a mipi hattak mansa abang uhi.
Amaute mu mipite alau ua; amelte uh ahong mual khin uhi.
Mihattak bang in atai ua; kidoumi bang in baang ah akah ua, amau zawn chiat ah apai ua, akivolhdan uh ahihbuai kei uhi.
Akiphu kha tuan kei ua; amau lampi ah apai chiat ua; galvante anawk paisuak ua, apialzak kei uh.
Khopi tung ah atawm ua; kulh tung ah atai ua; insungte ah akaltou ua; guta bang in tohlette ah alut uhi.
Ama uah lei aling a; vante aling hi; ni leh kha amial a, aksite'n avak uh asel uhi;
Huan TOUPA'N asepaihhonte ma ah a-aw asuah a; agiahbukte lah athupi ngal a; athu tangtungsakpa ahat a, TOUPA ni athupi in amulkimhuai ngal a, kua'n athuak thei mahmah dia?
TOUPA'N, huchipi in leng tu in na lungtang tengteng ua an ngawl a, kap a, lungkham in kei lam hong nga le uchin.
heading: Kisik A An Ngawl Ding A Chialna

paite: Na puante uh hilou in na lungtang uh botkek unla, TOUPA na Pathian lam nga un; amah hehpih theitak leh lainatna a dim, lungnel leh zahngaihna hau, thil hoih lou a kipan kik nawn sek ahi, achi hi.
TOUPA na Pathian un lungsim kihei in tangbuang leh dawn ding thillat ah vualzawlna nutsiat in a-om kei ding chih kua'n athei a?
Zion ah pengkul mut unla, an ngawl hun tang siangthou un, khawmpi taksuaktak bawl un.
Mipi kaikhawm unla, omkhawmte hihsiangthou unla, putekte, naupangte, nawitui ne laite kaikhawm unla; mouneite adantan a kipan in hong pawt uhenla, mou leng adantan sunggil a kipan in hong pawt hen.

Siampu, TOUPA nasem mite inlim leh maitam kikal ah kap uhenla; TOUPA aw, "Na mite hawi inla, na goutante gensiat a om namte'n atung ua vai ahawmsak ding un pe ke'n; 'A Pathian uh koi a om ahia,' chi in amipite lak ah bangziak a chi ding ahi ua?" chi uhen.
TOUPA'N agam thikthuse khop in adeihthoh a, amite ahehpih hi.
heading: Toupa'n Gam Avualzawl

paite: TOUPA'N amite kiang ah, Ngai unla, na kiang uah buhte, uainte, sathaute ka hon tungsak ding a, huaite in na tai ding ua; namte lak ah gensiat in ka hon omsak nawn kei ding.

Himahleh na kiang ua kipan in mallam sepaihhon ka suanmang ding a, gamkeu leh sia ah ka paisak ding, amasa pawl suahlam tuipi ah, ananung pawl tumlam tuipi ah; ahong uihkhe ding a, namsetak in ahong nam ding, thil thupitak ahih ziak in, chi in adawng hi.
Aw gam, lau ke'n, nuam in kipak in; TOUPA'N thil thupite ahihta hi.
Gante aw, lau kei un, gamdai loupa mun ahong sel a, sing ahong gah a, theipi kung leh grepgui ahong selpha ding hi.
Nou, Zion tate aw, kipak un, TOUPA na Pathian uah nuam un; noute a ding in vuah azusak a, akha khatna a vuah masa leh vuah nanung ahun lel ahon pe ding hi.
Pialkhangte buh in adim ding a, uain leh sathau belte adimlet ding uhi.
Na lak ua ka sepaihhon tampi ka sawl, khaukhupte, singnget khaute, khauhonte, leh khaupete'n anek khit kumte nou ka hon din nawn ding hi.
Tampi na ne ding ua, na tai ding ua, nou lamdangtak a hon ngaihtuah sekpa TOUPA na Pathian min na phat ding uh; ka mite azahlak ngei kei uhi.
Huan Israelte lak ah ka om chih leh TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi, kuamah dang a-om kei uh chih na thei ding uh; ka mite azahlak ngei nawn kei ding uhi.

Huai nung chiang in hichi ahong hi ding a, mi tengteng tung ah ka kha ka sung ding; huchi in na tapate, na tanute un ka thu agen ding ua, na putekte un mang aman ding ua, na tangvalte un kilaknate amu ding uh;
heading: TOUPA Kha Sunbuak Chiamna

paite: Huai ni chiang in sikhapate, sikhanute tung ah leng ka kha ka sungbo ding hi.
Vante leh leitung ah thillamdangte, sisan, mei leh meikhu ding ka musak ding hi.
Nisa mial asuak ding a, kha sisan asuak ding hi, TOUPA ni thupitak leh mulkimhuai ahong tun ma in.
Huan hichi ahong hi ding a, kuapeuh TOUPA min lou peuhmah humbit in a-om ding; TOUPA'N agen bang in, Zion tang ah leh Jerusalem khua ah akhosuaksunte a-om ding uhi.
